manual_contract: manual is class-derived once from carousel--manual and is never changed by user navigation.
On a non-manual instance, successful prev/next/dot/ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/qualified swipe calls go(...) then start(), resetting/restarting the 4000ms interval.
On a carousel--manual instance, autoplay is disabled from initialization; manual navigation still works but start() refuses a timer.
static_ax_gate: Synchronize source and target to slide 1/6 and pause movement without changing content.
Compare root/current/noncurrent AX roles/names and aria-hidden/current exposure.
Compare all six captions and image alts in DOM order.
Ignore historical unsynchronized source slide-2 versus target slide-1 role snapshots as write authority.
normal_motion_tests: If source root lacks carousel--manual and reduced-motion is off: >4.1s advances exactly once, and the next >4.1s advances exactly once.
After exactly one successful manual action, require the timer to restart rather than latch off; no old+new timer double-step.
Repeat reset/restart proof with one dot action and one Arrow key or qualifying swipe path.
pointer_keyboard_tests: ArrowRight exactly one forward; ArrowLeft exactly one backward.
Horizontal pointer swipe changes exactly one slide only when |dx|>=40 and |dx|>=|dy|.
Movement <40px or vertical-dominant movement does not change slide.
pause_resume_tests: mouseenter and focusin stop autoplay; mouseleave and focusout call start().
Because source tracks no independent hover/focus flags, compound exit order must match observed source behavior even if surprising.
Removing both pause conditions in either order must not create duplicate timers/double-step.
reduced_motion_tests: With reduced motion active, >8.2s yields no autoplay while manual controls remain functional.
On non-manual multi-slide source, toggling reduce true->false calls start() and may restart a fresh 4s timer; target must match source.
carousel--manual never enables autoplay through reduced-motion toggles.
broken_slide_contract: Do not deliberately break working media.
If a natural broken image leaves zero slides, source drop() calls stop(), hides the closest project/proof owner (or carousel), and returns.
If a natural broken image leaves exactly one slide, source drop() calls stop() before re-rendering; any existing autoplay timer is cancelled immediately.

If a natural broken image leaves at least two slides, source drop() removes slide+dot, reindexes/clamps and calls go(...), but does not stop/start; the existing interval is not reset solely by drop().
nordmann_carousel.failure_policy: Read the current deployed target owner and initialization marker before JavaScript/semantic change. Never create a second owner from missing evidence.

tests: Enumerate exact source/target question controls and initial expanded/collapsed state.
Pointer and native Enter/Space behavior must match source per item.
Observe source multi-open versus accordion behavior directly; do not impose a generic rule.
Preserve IDs, accessible names, answer ownership and restored fourth question.
faq_disclosures.failure_policy: Identify actual rendered/native/addon owner first; never create a second FAQ runtime from missing evidence.
